# opencode-terminal-guard

Temporary OpenCode TUI compatibility plugin for an upstream OpenTUI shutdown-order bug.

OpenTUI currently restores `stdin` from raw mode before it disables all-event mouse tracking. Mouse reports received in that window can remain queued and appear in the next shell command as text such as `35;56;53M`.

The guard wraps the live renderer's normal `destroy()` path. It disables mouse tracking while raw mode is still active, pauses and drains queued input, then delegates to the original shutdown routine.

## Install

```sh
opencode plugin opencode-terminal-guard --global
```

Or add it to the global `tui.json`:

```json
{
  "plugin": ["opencode-terminal-guard"]
}
```

Restart OpenCode after installation.

## Limits

This protects normal renderer destruction after TUI plugins load. No in-process cleanup can handle `SIGKILL`, and very early startup failures can happen before the guard activates.

Remove this plugin after OpenTUI ships and OpenCode bundles an upstream fix for [OpenTUI #904](https://github.com/anomalyco/opentui/issues/904) / [PR #905](https://github.com/anomalyco/opentui/pull/905).

## Development

```sh
bun install --frozen-lockfile
bun test
bun run build
npm pack --dry-run --json --ignore-scripts
```
